headline: 2026 NPB Golden Glove Awards: all 18 winners on the field
caption:
🧤 2026 NPB Golden Glove Awards

Hanshin led the 55th Mitsui Golden Glove Awards with five winners, including Triple Crown winner Teruaki Sato at third base for the second straight year. Orix took three spots on the Pacific League team, and Rakuten's Ryosuke Tatsumi won his sixth in a row.

Central League
P Katsuki Azuma (DeNA) · C Seishiro Sakamoto (Hanshin) · 1B Yusuke Oyama (Hanshin) · 2B Takumu Nakano (Hanshin) · 3B Teruaki Sato (Hanshin) · SS Yuta Izuguchi (Giants) · OF Shota Morishita (Hanshin), Ryuki Watarai (DeNA), Go Matsumoto (Giants)

Pacific League
P Kaima Taira (Seibu) · C Kenya Wakatsuki (Orix) · 1B Tyler Nevin (Seibu) · 2B Ryusei Ogawa (Lotte) · 3B Yuma Mune (Orix) · SS Kotaro Kurebayashi (Orix) · OF Ukyo Shuto (SoftBank), Ryosuke Tatsumi (Rakuten), Kyota Fujiwara (Lotte)

➡️ Swipe for both teams on the field.
👉 Full story via the link in our bio.
